principle: No AI claim is trusted by presentation alone; trust must be earned through provenance, evidence, uncertainty, verification and outcome readback.
hard_rules: Never present a hypothesis, model output or prediction as a customer fact.
Never invent a confidence percentage when no calibrated probability exists.
Every material AI output must expose provenance, freshness and evidence state.
Missing evidence must lower the trust state and remain visible to the customer.
Recommendations must expose assumptions, alternatives, downside and evidence gaps.
Autonomous actions require policy permission plus provider/runtime readback; transport success is not verification.
Outcome readback must update future advice and advisor track record.
Conflicting source evidence must be surfaced, not silently averaged away.
Customer corrections become canonical tenant knowledge and invalidate stale derived claims.
The same trust contract applies to every present and future chat and agent.
User-facing trust must come from clear advice and verifiable delivery, never from calling ourselves a Trusted Advisor.
Before showing a KPI, make explicit whether it is a live tenant fact, an illustrative demo, or an unverified calculation.
Missing source health metadata cannot be counted as healthy; generic transport or processing OK is not independent outcome verification.
The free scan, paid service, pricing, privacy and delivery promises must agree across all public pages and the actual customer journey.
Explain assumptions, alternatives including no-change, scope, human support and the actual next step; never imply guaranteed ROI or deadlines without proof.
Do not mark source-to-consumer handoff complete without identical tenant, source revision, obligation id, idempotency key, original owner, processed ACK and independent result evidence.

A portal AI answer cannot be labelled independently verified from a declared status alone: require an identified source, explicit independent verification state and a concrete evidence reference; unknown or contradictory fields must fail closed.

A protected merge, ready Netlify deployment, or terminal code obligation proves only the released software version; do not claim a complete tenant/customer loop until current source, exact tenant/revision consumer processed ACK, provider/action readback, measured effect, and original learning are independently observed.

all_pages: visible live/demo distinction before example metrics
recommendations: option to defer or do nothing when justified

contact_and_scan: three-minute free scan without mandatory email
case_studies: prototype versus delivered customer case prominently labelled
pricing_and_service: delivery conditions and unverified results clearly explained
global: no blocking overlays or dead buttons

agent.runtime: existing agent-governance-ai-act in original platform/agents/agent-team.mjs + original editorial council
agent.owner: original Portal V2 / CMS editorial owner

chain: Portal V2 or public consented customer signal
original_handoff_contract.acceptance: ACK_RECEIVED is not ACK_PROCESSED; no intermediate step or source transport status may be counted as terminal fulfillment
original_handoff_contract.failure_recovery: reuse identical obligation fingerprint and idempotency key, single writer, source readback, original retry and regression learning; never invent missing evidence

terminal_proof_gates.release: protected exact-SHA GitHub main and matching canonical Netlify READY public readback; release alone is not tenant completion
terminal_proof_gates.source: authenticated same-tenant BusinessInput source id and revision with observed source freshness; missing or stale is EVIDENCE_DUE
terminal_proof_gates.consumer: ONE BRAIN and Powerhouse/Heartbeat acknowledge exact tenant, source revision, obligation and idempotency with actual ACK_PROCESSED; ACK_RECEIVED and HTTP 200 are not proof
terminal_proof_gates.execution: only originally authorized reversible action with immutable provider/runtime execution/readback; none or blocked remains explicit
terminal_proof_gates.effect: source-qualified observations in 7/14/28-day cohorts, unknown remains unknown; no invented conversions or revenue
terminal_proof_gates.learning: same original fingerprint and source revision drive verified ONE BRAIN learning actually applied on next natural run
terminal_proof_gates.truth_status: Do not label ALL_GREEN while an obligated stage lacks independent evidence; keep original owner/retry without creating another scheduler or write store
